period.label: Persecución / Romani cante hondo concept album (1976)

position_in_era.primary_genre_lineage: cante jondo × narrative concept-album (Romani historical poetry) × Caló-language song cycle
position_in_era.historical_role: Lebrijano's signature 1976 concept album — narrating the persecution of the Romani people through poet Félix Grande's verses, breaking convention by introducing 'cante por galeras' as a vehicle for explicit historical narrative. One of the canonical modernizations of cante hondo: the deep singing voice carrying long-form poetic material rather than the traditional short copla. Anchors the upward / cante-root axis of the Orobroy lineage as the cante voice predecessor in the family line — Lebrijano (b. Juan Peña Fernández, Lebrija 1941) is Dorantes' uncle, brother of Pedro Peña, cousin of Pedro Bacán. Persecución sits historically just before the 1979 Camarón rupture and helped condition the appetite for cante carrying conceptual weight.

narrative_slots.production_facts: Released 1976 on Polydor Spain. Lyrics by poet Félix Grande, Lebrijano's principal literary collaborator. Introduced 'cante por galeras' as a song-form device. Lebrijano's later work would extend the methodology into symphony-orchestra contexts (e.g. *Encuentros*, 1983), but Persecución itself is a cante / guitar / palmas record, modernized by its conceptual-narrative ambition rather than its instrumentation.
narrative_slots.member_dynamics: Born Juan Peña Fernández, 1941, Lebrija. Belongs to the Perrate family of Utrera through his mother María 'la Perrata'. Brother of Pedro Peña; cousin of Pedro Bacán; uncle of Dorantes (David Peña Dorantes). Persecución preceded the family-collaboration phase by decades — the 2010 *Agua, Aire y Fuego* duet with his nephew Dorantes is encoded as a separate node (the closure-side Dorantes & Lebrijano collaboration), not bundled here.
narrative_slots.cultural_venue: Lebrija — a small Sevillian town that is one of the densest concentrations of Romani flamenco lineage in Spain.
narrative_slots.instrumentation_details: Cante (voice) plus flamenco guitar and palmas. The album's modernity is conceptual / textual, not instrumental.
narrative_slots.release_circumstances: *Persecución* canonical in cante-hondo discography; 50th anniversary commemorations in Lebrija municipal archive. Lebrijano died in 2016.
